name: Injoku Studio Saishuu Take ~Usugitanee Cinderella~
original_name: 淫辱スタジオ最終テイク～薄汚ねえシンデレラ
source:
"So you have been sold." Sayoko, my sex slave, coldly tells Emiri, who is from a rich family. Her father used to run a big talent agency, but it went bankrupt and he went missing with his wife. I worked with Emiri several times before, but she was very selfish. But it is different this time. She comes to me as a voice actress. Well, I'll make her my sex slave....
